old_caption: The video depicts a close-up view of a white car's front wheel being cleaned with a high-pressure water hose. The camera focuses on the tire and wheel, capturing the water spraying from the hose and rinsing off dirt and grime. The person operating the hose is partially visible, showing only their hand gripping the black nozzle. The background is slightly blurred, emphasizing the action around the wheel. The water creates a direct jet as it hits the tire and rim, gradually revealing a cleaner surface underneath. The scene is set on a wet ground surface, with the car's body and fender visible in the frame, alongside the cleaning activity.

caption: The video depicts a close view of a white car's wheel on a dark speckled surface. A silver five-spoke alloy rim with a center logo sits inside a black tire marked by raised TR lettering. A pressure-washer spray jet is already directed at the lower right of the tire. The black spray gun and a hand enter from the right edge, angling the fan-shaped jet upward along the wheel's side. The jet tracks across the upper right rim toward the tire's top edge, while mist and droplets scatter around the spray. The rim's spokes, center logo, and tire lettering remain fixed, showing that the wheel is not rotating. Wet sheen forms on the tire and rim, and water runs down the rubber as the spraying continues. The white body panel, black mud flap, and ground remain fixed, keeping the view static while the gun moves around the wheel.
